review_evidence: README identifies FFaCiL as Finite Fields and Curves in Lean.

FFaCiL/EllipticCurve.lean defines Curve over a field, discriminant and j-invariant, projective and affine curve points, on-curve predicates, point addition/doubling/scalar multiplication, CurveGroup, and finite-field point enumeration.

A complete scan of 15 Lean files found 138 declaration-style items. Even without theorem declarations at this revision, the mathematical definitions, structures and constructions are directly reusable formal prior art and must remain searchable.
summary: Reviewed FFaCiL.lean and retain its formal finite-field and elliptic-curve structures and constructions.
